description: Get the completion status of up to 500 orders (unscheduled, scheduled, on_route, servicing, success, failed, rejected, cancelled) with service start/end times and positions, proof-of-delivery form data (notes, signature and photo URLs, barcodes), the tracking URL and optionally customer feedback. Read-only despite using POST. OptimoRoute: POST /get_completion_details.

includeCustomerFeedback.description: Include the customer's rating and comment, if customer feedback is configured.

orders.description: Orders to target, each {"orderNo": "..."} or {"id": "..."}. At most 500.

name: optimoroute_get_completion_details
title: Get order completion details
